government_sources.notes: Volume 2 of 4 (PDF) — live-verified 2026-09-25 to contain the real Subclass 189/190/491 Schedule 2 criteria text ('Schedule 2, Subclasses 010 to 801'), not just an index. The previous URL (/latest/text) is an interactive expand-tree UI with no static text; Volume 2's fixed PDF deep-link is the actual authoritative text. CAVEAT: this URL embeds the compilation date (2026-07-01 twice) and Federal Register of Legislation does not appear to offer a stable non-dated permalink to volume text — when this regulation is next amended and re-compiled, the URL will need to be re-derived (fetch /latest/downloads with a real browser, since download links are JS-rendered, and read the new dated href for Volume 2's PDF).
